sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
When we met last time, we talked about the importance of prayer. Today, we are going to learn how to abide in Christ.
1 John 4:16
John 15:1-17 (The Vine and the Branches)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
Without abiding in Christ, we cannot bear good fruit.
Those who abide in Christ will bear much fruit.
We should spend time in God’s Word every day.
When we abide in Christ, we will pray like Jesus would pray.
Jesus is our friend.
We didn’t choose Jesus, but He chose us so we will bear much fruit.
Followers of Jesus should show love to one another.
God’s Word must abide in us.
Abiding in Christ means to pray to Him.
It is out of love for God that we keep His commandments.
It is important for us to abide in His love. Always remember that we are loved by Jesus.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Read Part 2 of this lesson and Practice Abiding in Christ.
Continue reading from Matthew 5:6-9
Continue sharing the gospel with your family and friends!
To whom will you tell Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
One day every nation (ethnic group), tribe, people and language will stand before the throne of God in worship. Let’s commit to take the Gospel to everyone
Revelation 7:9-10
Pray
Ask God to help us abide in Christ and live a life surrendered to God. Thank Him for using His Word to bring us closer to Him.
